basic_info.description: Elegantly updated 2-bedroom 2-bathroom condominium in sought after location at the crossroads of Pacific Heights & Nob Hill.  Built in 2000 this expansive open floor plan boasts an abundance of gracious living space with attractive wood flooring, custom paint and recessed lighting.  Professionally equipped kitchen provides Stainless Steel Appliances, Gas Range/Hood, D/W and Sleek Kitchen Island with seating and marble counter. Grand sized Living/Dining room is offset by corner stone gas fireplace creating a warm and inviting entertaining area.  Positioned for privacy off the central hallway is the Primary Suite with impressive closet space, recessed lighting, sensational stone bath with shower over tub and private outdoor courtyard patio - creates the perfect retreat for relaxing after a long day. Brand new stacked LG Washer/Dryer located in the laundry closet with Full Sized Guest Bath and Second Bedroom flooded with natural light. One car garage parking space on lower level and sensational Golden Gate Bridge Views from the common area roof deck. Easy Walking distance to all of your favorite neighborhood restaurants, shops and cafes lining Polk Street with convenient public transpiration nearby. This outstanding residence has it all!
